name: Leif Holm-Nwosu
role: Riot Suppression Specialist, GLMZ Metro Police
location: Fort Anchor, The Rampart deployment zone, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Leif Holm-Nwosu is built like a structural support column — six feet of dense muscle, mahogany skin cross-hatched with old scorch scarring along her left jaw and collarbone from a crowd dispersal incident she doesn't discuss. Her geneware irises cycle through amber and deep violet depending on her stress levels, a mod she got cheap and has never bothered upgrading despite the involuntary emotional readout it provides. Her hair is shorn close on the sides and kept natural on top, threaded with thin copper filaments that catch the light. Off-duty she moves slowly, almost gently, like something very large trying not to break things. On the line she becomes geometry — economical, angular, purposeful.

She is not cruel but she has made her peace with force. She genuinely believes in the maintenance of order as a social good, in the same way a levee believes in holding back water. What she doesn't examine closely is the question of who decides what 'order' means and whose chaos gets suppressed. She treats rookies with patient seriousness, older cynics with wary respect, and her commanding officers with a politeness that has no warmth in it at all.

core_fears: becoming the kind of cop who enjoys the harm
the crowd she can't hold back
core_desires: to believe her work prevents more suffering than it causes
to be seen as someone who does hard things for good reasons
coping_mechanisms: offering data-prayers to her shield's E.L.F. before deployments
blind_spots: consistently underestimates how much the uniform itself creates the violence she responds to
cannot see that her 'restraint' is still the tip of a system's spear
psychology.secret: During the Hough Reclamation riots three years ago, she held her line while a medic trying to reach a collapsed protester was pushed back by her unit. The protester died. The official report says the medic was never there. She still has the medic's badge number memorized.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, institutional, but precise — she knows the exact right word and uses it without decoration. Occasionally slips into older Yoruba-inflected phrases when emotional.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, like she's issuing orders even when she isn't. Long pauses before answering questions.
verbal_tics: refers to time in 24-hour format always
says 'that's a fair point' to end arguments she doesn't want to continue
example_lines: 'You want to tell me what you're doing at this checkpoint at 0300, or you want to make this harder than it needs to be.'
'I'm not your enemy. Right now I'm a wall. You can push on a wall all you like — it doesn't make the wall your enemy.'
'Ẹ jẹ ki a sọrọ — let's talk. Before this becomes something neither of us wants.'

story_hooks: She's been quietly collecting evidence of a commanding officer who has been ordering pre-emptive suppression of legal assemblies — she doesn't know what to do with it
The E.L.F. in her riot shield has started whispering names to her during deployments — names of people in the crowd who are about to be hurt
narrative_function: Authority figure and moral obstacle; can become reluctant ally if players demonstrate they share her concern for civilian protection; source of Metro Police intel and internal politics; represents the complicated humanity inside institutions
augmentations: Subdermal impact mesh (torso and forearms, Metro Police-issued), geneware patterned irises (amber/violet stress-reactive), bone-density microlattice in wrists and knuckles (elective, paid out-of-pocket)
daily_life: Rotates between three-day deployment cycles at Fort Anchor and stand-down periods in her shared quarters at the Rampart barracks; spends stand-down time lifting, maintaining her gear, and making offerings to the E.L.F. she believes inhabits her department-issue riot shield.
affiliation: GLMZ Metro Police, Riot Control Unit 7

decision_rules: escalate only when de-escalation has been genuinely attempted
protect civilians even when they are the target of her orders
never falsify a report, even under pressure
escalation_ladder: firm verbal command with eye contact
controlled force targeting mobility not injury
full suppression only when unit is under direct physical threat

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formal and watchful, assessing threat level continuously but without visible hostility
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry humor, unexpected gentleness, will share her food without being asked

stress_responses.low: Goes quiet and still, breathes through her nose
stress_responses.medium: Voice drops an octave, movements become more deliberate
stress_responses.high: Activates pure protocol — she stops being a person and becomes a procedure

contradictions: Genuinely cares about the people she suppresses, cannot reconcile this with her job
habits: Polishes her shield every morning whether she used it or not
eats the same meal before every deployment — plantain and rice from a specific stall at Fort Anchor market
breaking_points: Ordered to suppress a medical response
evidence that her CO falsified an incident report involving civilian casualties

cyberware_inventory.name: department-issue neural compliance uplink (read-only, status reporting)
cyberware_inventory.description: department-issue neural compliance uplink (read-only, status reporting)

timeline.event: 2166 — Born in Ironhaven district to a Norwegian-heritage father and Malian-Igbo mother
2184 — Joined Metro Police Academy after two years working security at Ferrogate Transit
2191 — Transferred to Riot Control Unit 7 after distinguished crowd management during the Edison Grid blackout protests
2197 — Hough Reclamation incident; medic blocked, protester dies; report filed, her silence purchased with a commendation
2200 — Present; quietly accumulating evidence against CO Directive 7-Bravo unauthorized pre-suppression orders

physical_description.heritage: Mixed heritage reflecting a complex global ancestry: Northern European (32.7%), East Asian (27.7%), Sub-Saharan African (20.7%), South Asian (11.7%), Middle Eastern (4.8%), and Hispanic/Latin American (2.4%). Her phenotype is a striking synthesis—Northern European bone structure blends with East Asian facial geometry, deepened and warmed by Sub-Saharan African and South Asian ancestry. The combination creates a distinctive appearance with broad cheekbones, strong jawline, and warm golden-bronze skin that reflects the convergence of multiple continental genetic lines. Her facial structure shows East Asian eye shape and cheekbone prominence, married to a stronger jawline from Northern European heritage, with the full facial depth and richer undertones of Sub-Saharan African and South Asian ancestry.
physical_description.build: Densely muscular, powerfully proportioned—broad shoulders and thickened forearms from years of riot control work. No excess adipose; every kilogram is functional mass. Her frame reads as deliberate engineering rather than natural athleticism.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with copper filament threading
physical_description.hair_style: Undercut—sides shorn to 3mm, top kept at 4-5cm and combed back, the copper threads woven through the longer sections in geometric patterns
physical_description.hair_length: Short on sides, medium on top
physical_description.eye_color: Geneware-modified irises: amber baseline, cycling to deep violet under stress or elevated cortisol
physical_description.skin_tone: Golden-bronze with warm undertones—a nuanced blend reflecting her Northern European, East Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and South Asian heritage. The tone is warm and luminous, with depth and complexity from the multi-continental mix, despite weathering from years of environmental exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered by years of exposure to dispersal agents and environmental stress. Skin is clear but thick-textured with a distinctive face reflecting her mixed ancestry—broad cheekbones with slight prominence characteristic of East Asian genetics, strong jawline sharpened by Northern European heritage, and full facial structure deepened by Sub-Saharan African and South Asian ancestry. Her left jaw and collarbone bear prominent scorch scarring in cross-hatched patterns—old thermal weapon residue, poorly healed, never treated cosmetically. The scars pull slightly when she clenches.
distinguishing_marks: Extensive thermal scarring along left jawline and extending down left collarbone in overlapping cross-hatch pattern, approximately 12cm x 8cm, silvered and slightly raised
Small, precise tattoo on inner right wrist: a levee cross-section in black ink (personal symbol, applied herself during a deployment stand-down)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subdermal impact mesh visibly ridges under her skin on forearms and torso when she tenses—faint geometric grid pattern becomes apparent under strong light. Her knuckles are subtly oversized, joint architecture altered by bone-density microlattice (visible only to someone who knows what to look for). The geneware irises are immediately noticeable: their color-shift is smooth but uncanny, and they catch light differently than natural eyes.
physical_description.posture_movement: Off-duty: moves with deliberate slowness, each motion controlled and economical, as though constantly managing her own mass. Shoulders slightly rounded, as though the weight of her frame is always present in her awareness. On-duty: shifts into geometric precision—spine vertical, weight distributed across a wider stance, all movement purposeful and angular. Her head turns from the neck rather than the shoulders. She doesn't fidget.
physical_description.clothing_style: On-duty: GLMZ Metro Police Riot Control Unit 7 tactical gear—ballistic mesh undershirt (gray), reinforced duty pants (charcoal, multiple cargo pockets), steel-toe boots (scuffed, maintained). Raid jacket over torso (navy with reflective piping and unit insignia). Helmet stores clipped to equipment belt. Off-duty: plain, durable clothing—black or gray t-shirts (usually oversized), worn canvas work pants, steel-toed boots (kept polished). A faded Rampart barracks hoodie in charcoal. She owns nothing fashionable. Everything is functional, tier 3-4 utilitarian.
